name: storywork
description: storyhook-based dispatch actuator: story.sh dispatch <id> claims a story via storyhook's --if-state CAS primitive and hands it off to a fresh plan-mode Claude session in a new tmux window + per-story worktree; story.sh complete <id> cleans up its merged worktree/branch (never touches story state -- the caller performs the actual state transition). HARD DEPENDENCY: sources plugins/issue/lib/session.sh, so the `issue` plugin must also be installed alongside `storywork`.
